data.one_liner: Extension to flutter_markdown_plus that renders LaTeX in markdown.
data.what_it_does: Adds support for inline and block LaTeX syntax to flutter_markdown_plus using flutter_math_fork. It provides builders and syntax classes to parse and display mathematical expressions.
use_when: You need to display LaTeX equations in markdown content.
You already use flutter_markdown_plus and want a single package for LaTeX support.
avoid_when: You are not using flutter_markdown_plus or need a different markdown renderer.
You require advanced math rendering beyond basic LaTeX support.
strengths: Simple integration with existing flutter_markdown_plus setup.
Supports both inline and block LaTeX with custom styling.
No additional build_runner or code generation required.
weaknesses: Only works with flutter_markdown_plus; not compatible with flutter_markdown.
Relies on flutter_math_fork, which may have its own limitations.
No support for custom LaTeX packages or advanced rendering options.
No active maintenance beyond dependency updates (latest changelog only updates dependencies).
data.setup_notes: Add dependency to pubspec, import the package, and use LatexElementBuilder with appropriate extensionSet.
